subsidies_eur: ~6,300,000,000 EUR/year EU CAP funds to Germany (2023-2027); EU-wide 38.16bn direct payments + 12.95bn rural development (2023)
highlights: Bundestag postponed the mandatory animal-husbandry label again on 15 Jan 2026 (Drs. 21/3292) - second delay after the 1 Aug 2025 -> 1 Mar 2026 shift; Green motions to keep the original date rejected.
BMLEH is preparing a third amendment plus a Fifth Act amending the Animal Welfare Act; Albert Schweitzer Stiftung calls the draft a clear improvement.
Germany receives about 6.3 bn EUR/year in EU CAP money; German direct payments run around 280 EUR per hectare per year, paid per area not per welfare outcome.
Deutscher Bauernverband declares 4,930,001-4,940,000 EUR lobbying spend for 2024 (~20.6 FTE lobbyists); Copa-Cogeca declared ~1.6m EUR for 530 EU meetings.
Agriculture GHG emissions fell 85.8 -> 60.8 Mt CO2-eq 1990-2025 (-29%, UBA), but veterinary antibiotic volumes rose again to ~562 t in 2024 after 529 t in 2023 (BVL).
